descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S27 Generate on patient A, open patient B at once: A's dictation stays on A and nothing of A lands on B (both contexts, not gated)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with two Hospital patients ({hospitalPatient}, {hospitalPatient2}) and two Nursing Home residents ({snfResident}, {snfResident2}), seeded as TC-14 S07 does; main e02167f, where the client orchestrates Generate and saves the note itself

When On A's Encounter tab type the dictation and tap Generate Note & Finish, open B's chart at once, wait 45 s on B, then return to A. Same in Nursing Home

Then B's Post-Round and Encounter tabs show nothing of A's dictation or note; A's Encounter tab still holds the dictation; A has the note, an explicit failure, or no note yet (whether the note is there on return is S15, gated)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): B's checkpoints mustNotContain A's dictation; A's Encounter checkpoint mustContain it. Backend: B's note is empty and B's encounterNotes unchanged; A's encounterNotes equals the typed text. Not gated by TFA-92592: a lost dictation or anything of A on B is a Fail on main

Where it ran: dev unit U65; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)
